comment: Governance of the reference architecture itself is thin: no named custodian, versioning policy, or change process ('living model' intentions stated but not operationalized); the reference list and several glossary entries are placeholders. The living home appears to already exist - the smart-ra implementation guide (smart.who.int/ra; WorldHealthOrganization/smart-ra), where the TWG governance framework is published and ArchiMate-to-IG tooling is under active development - but the published build is v0.1.0 (July 2025), a year behind this draft, and the document never names or links it.

public.text: Governance of the reference architecture itself is thin: no named custodian, versioning policy, or change process ('living model' intentions stated but not operationalized); the reference list and several glossary entries are placeholders. The living home appears to already exist - the smart-ra implementation guide (smart.who.int/ra; WorldHealthOrganization/smart-ra), where the TWG governance framework is published and ArchiMate-to-IG tooling is under active development - but the published build is v0.1.0 (July 2025), a year behind this draft, and the document never names or links it.
public.suggestedRevision: Before publication: complete references/glossary; name the custodian, versioning scheme, and revision cadence; identify the smart-ra IG as the canonical machine-readable home, publish a build synchronized with the consultation text, and route post-consultation feedback through its public issue tracker.
